services.title: Tires and wheels
services.body: Fitting, balancing and rotation on the machine, with the weights set where they belong.

services.title: Diagnostics and check engine work
services.body: The fault gets traced to its actual cause before anything is replaced, so you pay for the part that failed and not the three beside it.

photos_h2: What we have been working on

reviews.author: Teresa Goodman
reviews.text: Excellent service. Cheryl was so helpful- very professional! The entire crew was great! Everyone was very helpful and the service was quick! I was camping at Kerr lake and needed a new tire for my airstream. After trying several places in the area- Cheryl happily gave me an appointment!

reviews.author: Tiarrah Small
reviews.text: Been a loyal customer with Cheryl and her crew for over 5 years. If you want true mechanics at a decent price. Come on down to Henderson to receive the upmost affordable auto services. They will never let you down !!!!! They have saved my car plenty of times..

reviews.author: Jason Howe
reviews.text: Danger, Danger! I'd never had an issue with this place... until I did. They caused damage and wouldn't admit it... just kept saying their employee was perfect and must have been pure coincidence. Don't trust them... don't go here! If you saw their reply, you'll understand why I'm doubling down on my warning. They didn't mention the video I sent them showing my Jeep didn't leak before taking it in for a specific repair. They are deceitful saying air in the cooling system would have had an immediate impact. And it's a lie when they say my Jeep didn't have issues on my drive home. I've already notified them of a pending lawsuit which is why they responded with their dishonest words. STAY AWAY!!

reviews.author: Mary Blais
reviews.text: Highly recommend! I had my vehicle towed to Pete Smith Lube & Tire on the recommendation of the tow truck driver after my ac compressor seized and a belt snapped while on 85. I am so glad I did. The staff was amazingly kind, straightforward with possible timelines and potential causes of delays, and worked hard to get my vehicle fixed and back on the road same day. I was an hour and a half from home, returning from a weekend out of state, traveling with my 3 children. I am so grateful for the service I received here. Thank you!

reviews.author: David Adcock
reviews.text: Best place to go if you actually want your vehicle fixed. I went to 3 different places spent over $2000 for the other places to misdiagnose the problem & charge me money I didn’t have to spend. Only 30 mins at Pete Smith & they already diagnosed the problem & now my car drives like brand new. Shouldve just went by Pete smith in the first place. Great work & Honest people. I will NOT go anywhere else.

reviews.author: John Gillis
reviews.text: I was traveling from Georgia and my truck broke down and I found this place and they have done everything in their power to get me back on the road safely. I would recommend this place to anyone. Thanks Cheryl you’re the greatest!!

reviews.author: amber charette
reviews.text: Five stars! Highly recommend! They saved my tire and my road trip when I was about an hour from home! Cheryl at the desk is A++. Thank yall!

reviews.author: Ginger Tevepaugh
reviews.text: I recently had my turbocharger replaced, and the customer service was outstanding! Brian took the time to explain each step of the process, from diagnostics to the repair itself, and kept me updated throughout. The work was done quickly and efficiently, much faster than the last shop I used back in 2024. I highly recommend Pete Smith for all your automotive needs. Great service and communication from start to finish!

reviews.author: Melissa Winn
reviews.text: Our first time visiting here and the customer service was incredible we got an oil change and a tire rotation ! We definitely will be back. Brian helped us and he was great to work with

reviews.author: John Gillis
reviews.text: This is the best place I have gotten service done. They definitely will work with you on any problem you have.

reviews.author: Arjenis Luciano
reviews.text: Got a wheel alignment a few weeks ago it got messed up within the first few hundred miles…they said I hit a pot hole. They only charged me for the “service fee” & it was the same price i paid the first time $100. Got the alignment re done and its still garbage. Told them that the key to my lug nuts CANNOT BE USED ON A POWERTOOL, they stripped the whole key. I have to pay $30 for a new one.

reviews.author: Myiah Robinson
reviews.text: We stopped here today after discovering one of my tires was rapidly going flat. Unfortunately, because of the location of the nail in my tire, we couldn’t get the tire patched. After air was put into the tire, the manager, Cheryl, advised us on the closest place where we could get a replacement tire. She was so kind and said she just wanted us to get to our destination safely. Though we didn’t have an actual service done, the customer service and compassion were top notch! Thank you Cheryl!

reviews.author: Scarbro Family
reviews.text: Very Friendly and knowledgeable. Definitely would recommend. Feel very comfortable bringing all my vehicles here. Family owned!

reviews.author: Kimberly Brown
reviews.text: These guys are the best. Always professional and quick! Someone recommended that I come here and I approve. Corey and Cheryl are at the front desk, and are always nice and friendly. They’re affordable and I’m happy to have them. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Stephanie Bender
reviews.text: Quick, knowledgeable and thoughtful service. The team was extremely helpful at getting me back on the road ASAP after I busted a tire on the highway. Waiting area is clean and well maintained. I would definitely receive service here again!

reviews.author: Mary Walker
reviews.text: I was traveling back from my dad's funeral in Maryland and returning to Salisbury NC. My tire blew out and I was directed to this business. It was 12:45 on Saturday and the business closed at 1. They helped me get a new tire and we're so kind and compassionate.

reviews.author: monica bullock
reviews.text: I’m giving 5 stars just for the estimate. The lovely woman on the phone was so kind and knowledgeable, gave me specific prices, helped me look up my engine size and details, located parts, and gave me helpful information for dealing with reimbursement.

reviews.author: Benji Hight
reviews.text: Picked up a nail along the side of 39 called Pete Smith tire and in 45 minutes. I was back on my way.

reviews.author: kisha cintron
reviews.text: I wish I can leave at least 10 stars! Our family of 6 was on a roadtrip when the belt of our vehicle broke and the tow truck took us here. The two gentleman that took care of us were amazing and efficient. Thank you and God bless. (Victor Zapata)

reviews.author: Lori Hedglin
reviews.text: Pete Smith Tire and Lube - (Parker) - Was the best stroke of luck we could have! In the middle of moving my check engine light came on and was flashing. We had the code checked and they recommended, Pete's. Not being from the area and still had 5 hours to go in our trip to get us to our new home. They worked with us to find a hotel, and patiently wait as we downloaded animals and bags from the vehicle. Parker was kind, professional, and understanding with our matter. The vehicle was done on time and serviced. Integrity with an honest diagnoses and compassion with our circumstances. Also I may say, as I sat and observed Parker with the local customers. He was patient and respectful. Thank you to the whole team that succeeded to get us to our destination safely.

reviews.author: Gilbert Munoz
reviews.text: This place has the best customer service. The family and I were traveling back to Texas and we needed a tire changed. The shop manager volunteered to stay back and help us out. They took us in at 5:55 and stayed late to help us out and get us back on the road. God bless them all. Sheryl (sorry if I missed spelled the your name) was the nicest lady I've met in a long while. Over all they were quick and amazing. I would strongly recommend this shop to anyone that needs their services.

reviews.author: Kayleigh Bonel
reviews.text: Broke down on a road trip and ended up coming here for work. They started working on our car quickly and gave us an estimate, when the work ended up being a bit more they still honored the original quote. The manager, Cheryl, was very compassionate and made sure my family was comfortable while we waited to get the work done.

reviews.author: Rosa Messer
reviews.text: Wonderful staff. Accommodated us after our tire blew on 85. Friendly and got us back on the road to make our son’s game in Richmond. Cannot thank them enough for their help!

reviews.author: Korishia Taylor
reviews.text: Pete Smith Lube & Tire helped us with a clients car. Not only did they provide an exceptional experience but they even assisted our guest with a ride home as we worked out additional transportation. Cheryl worked our guest in on a very busy Saturday to ensure that her car was safe. The whole process we worked together as team to make sure the guest was taken care of. EchoPark Raleigh's team would recommend time and time again. Cheryl communicated regularly, as well as, provided honest and efficient work.

reviews.author: William Weitz
reviews.text: I ended up not being service because my vehicle was totaled. I was stranded 2 hours from home and the whole staff was wonderful. Cheryl helped me figure out my options and used her personal connections to make sure I got home safe. The mechanics where incredibly nice and relatable, I do most of my own auto work and they talked to me as an equal.

reviews.author: Shaheed Scott
reviews.text: Been here twice on different ventures. First time was when my sway bar and links were damaged. And again when my taillights needed to be replaced and get a car inspection. These folks did their homework and got my car running perfectly both times. This is definitely my favorite place in Henderson to get my car fixed.

reviews.author: Marie Mcmillan
reviews.text: My daughter was on a road trip from Atlanta to Richmond and her car broke down late Friday evening on the side of I-85. We had it towed early the next morning to Pete Smith’s and they had it fixed for her before closing time on Saturday! I can’t say enough wonderful things about the kind, thoughtful and caring service we received. Highly recommend is not even enough of a recommendation for Pete Smith’s!! They’re the absolute best!! A+++ I am one grateful and thankful Momma! My baby girl is able to head back to Atlanta on time and safely!! Thanks to the entire team, and especially to Cheryl, for all her help over the phone to get the job completed!!

reviews.author: Sara Yetsko
reviews.text: Despite the fact that the woman who initially waited on us was really rude, abrasive, and dismissive, we received great service. Our car was inspected quickly and there wasn't a wait. The gentlman who checked us out when the car was done was very friendly and personable. His demeanor made up for her lack of hospitality.

reviews.author: Alexis Nesbitt
reviews.text: Glenn and C.J. were amazing! I was in and out in no time. They took the time to teach me some things about my vehicle and we’re completely professional. I’ve definitely found my go to place for all my maintenance and repair needs.

reviews.author: Craig Shipley
reviews.text: Cheryl and the team at Pete Smith were awesome. My tire blew late on a Friday and they recommended a tow and stayed to change my tire. Thank you for all your help.

reviews.author: Odins Wyrd
reviews.text: Took my mother’s van for a flat tire they did a good job, so I took my father’s truck by when it needed an oil change they got me in and out fast. So when my tire went flat took it by I knew I just needed front tires and that I had some rim damage from a previous issue but I didn’t say anything. I only told them I wasn’t sure but I would like them to check all tires. They were very honest told me I only needed two front tires and even notified me that there was some rim damage that I need to be aware of even though it wouldn’t effect the setting of the seal. I am now taking all my families vehicles here including my business vehicles. Very impressed!

reviews.author: Brandon Abel
reviews.text: Mr Cheryl has always been a big help every time I go in! Yesterday my wife’s car broke down a couple buildings down and she helped do all she could to help out. Thanks a lot! If anyone needs work don’t to there vehicle definitely stop by and see her first!

reviews.author: Gerry Fontaine
reviews.text: I had my car towed there for a broken brake line. They said there was too much rust. The real problem was that there was some surface rust because we went under the car when it came back. The reality was they were afraid that they would disturb other parts that might break. I'm not upset, just disappointed that they weren't truthful. Remember that being honest will bring in customers. I won't ever go back. You lost my trust in you!!

reviews.author: Karen King
reviews.text: If I could give them 10 stars, I would. They were wonderful! We were on the road from Williamsburg, VA to Asheville, NC when I saw the engine temp was running hot, but the radiator was full. We pulled over to find a local repair shop. Pete Smith's was the third place we called. No one else would help because they were closing soon on a Saturday afternoon. Pete's took us and thank God because my radiator had cracked. They replaced it while we went to eat lunch. I can't say enough good things about their kindness, speed, and just general willingness to help my family. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: gentry wales
reviews.text: Cheryl saved us from breaking down at Hibernia Campground to drive back over 100 miles to home with oil sensor that was leaking pressure too on our truck. She was so nice and helpful!

reviews.author: Lynn Fields Smith
reviews.text: Dear Cheryl and James...Want to take this time and THANK YOU and your staff for ALWAYS providing knowledgeable, professional and honest services! We have needed maintenance services over the last few months in which the quality of your services have been EXCELLENT! We look forward to doing business with you in the near future! Thank you! Jason and Lynn Smith

reviews.author: Christy Overbey
reviews.text: I was in this business the other day waiting on my car to be fixed and heard this lady that works there name Cheryl be so hateful and rude to a parts delivery person when they came in, the parts person was trying to ignore her tone and attitude. They were nice to her, I commend that person for being nice and professional, there was no excuse for what I heard, I will not go back as long as she is working there and I will tell everyone I know, Cheryl does not need to be working with the public at all.

reviews.author: Donald Lowery
reviews.text: I went in, after lunch, to get my car inspected on the last I could renew my tag without paying a fine. They worked me in, inspected the car AND went on line and renewed my license plate so I didn't need to stand in line at the DMV office. This was service above and beyond the call of duty and all done with a smile in the spirit of helpfulness. I give my highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Me Too
reviews.text: I took my vehicle in for making a weird noise. They charged me over 750 to fix my car, said it was tire rods. Vehicle making the same noise. then told me the struts need replacing after making the initial diagnosis. Obviously, it was the struts because it is the same noise as before. highly disappointed. I was confused, just wanted the vehicle fixed. Car making the same noise as it was before I took it earlier this week. The first time I used them, I was impressed. Not this time! Just say the mechanic made a mistake or misdiagnosed the vehicle the first time. They kindly offered to fix the struts, didn't want to take a chance with the organization anymore.

reviews.author: Quincy Williams
reviews.text: Well from my first time ever being there i did look at all the reviews before I took my vehicle, but despite the negative stuff i hear about them i decided to go for myself.. To my knowledge they did a good job on my vehicle, just wish they communicated more with other employees .. A lady called me at 10:30 am and told me my tires were in, I replied ok ill be on my way, before I can get out the door a man calls back to say they cant get to my vehicle till about 3 or 4 pm.. I had high hopes to have g or my vehicle in and out early was very disappointed... But overall they did A1 on my tires I would visit them again ..

reviews.author: Pete Harvey
reviews.text: I went in and had my alternator repaired and they broke the visor on the front of my hood and said they were not responsible for replacing it and I think that just wasn't right. I had a couple bad experience with them so I won't be using them anymore.

reviews.author: gcode BDA King
reviews.text: The job was done correctly, but the customer service lady is very rude. Every time I call she either doesn't know and have to call back but never do, or she hangs up

reviews.author: Agnes Williams
reviews.text: My experience with Pete Smith gets better every time I go... the staff are the most welcoming, honest people ever..as of today, they will have my business forever.... I trust them to the highest!!!

reviews.author: Tina Kreidler
reviews.text: Thought I had an issue with the motor due to an unusual noise, but they looked it over and hooked the computer up and everything was fine. Great customer service!

reviews.author: April Sparks
reviews.text: Because they do stuff to your car that' you don't ask for and then charge you a crazy price on stuff that you didn't want, all I wanted was a oil change and they took it apond theirselves to do other stuff I didn't ask for, just because they thought it needed, didn't mean that they just do it without asking me first!!!!!!!!! But Trust me I will not be going back there

reviews.author: Curtis Ray
reviews.text: My go to place for mechanic work. They do their best to get you in and out as fast as possible and charge a reasonable price for their services. I highly recommend Pete Smith lube and tire!

reviews.author: Denise Alston
reviews.text: Our experience was excellent..Cheryl was the best..she took time to explain and listen to my daughter ..my daughter said Cheryl was employee of the year for being patience and understanding...Pete Smith gives top service !!!!

reviews.author: Kim Aubin
reviews.text: Last time I went in for oil service, technician failed to bolt up splash guard for oil pan. Went back to have them fix it because it was hanging, only put 1 bolt in, left others loose, now hanging again. Failure to pay attention to details, (this could have been the drain plug) so now we have to go to dealer for repair.

reviews.author: Margaret Donley
reviews.text: Very helpful we dealt with James and a mechanic when our truck broke down due to a faulty repairs done earlier. Thanks to them we got back on e road!!

reviews.author: Bill Campbell
reviews.text: Great service. Was able to squeeze me in and get me back on the road after a break down. Very friendly with good mechanics

reviews.author: John Grissom
reviews.text: Good to have your car worked on and nice people that works there. One man by the name Justin is very nice and very polite.

reviews.author: Ann Bullock
reviews.text: First car was ready in about 3 days. Second car has been in shop a week. They still don't know what is wrong with it.

reviews.author: John Walter Ruiz Castro
reviews.text: Excellent service. Thanks God my car was okay, but they still did something to it. Everything was clear.

reviews.author: Michael Smith
reviews.text: Unlike some places who fix cars,Pete Smith Lube and Tire Always gives you your money's worth and then some.The people are patient and actually listen to their customers.I will be getting all my vehicle inspections and car repairs done at Pete Smith's from here on out.

reviews.author: Gwen Matthews
reviews.text: I've never had a bad experience at Peter Smith, always professional and always knowledgeable; and I've never felt taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Kevin Glover
reviews.text: Great location. Was in to get car inspection. It was completed in a timely manner with Covid-19 practices in place.

reviews.author: Lucille Nicholas
reviews.text: Service is wonderful Tire need fixing but they took care the problem ...l was by on the road.... great service

reviews.author: kingsleywray
reviews.text: I didn't get what I went about for my vehicle. I was told I had come back another day, time which I didn't have.

reviews.author: Reneka Colbert
reviews.text: The worst experience ever!!!! After the technician destroyed my engine they haven't taken responsibility for their actions

reviews.author: Delilah Watson
reviews.text: These people dont care about there customers... all they care about is how fast they can push the vehicles out the door !!!!

reviews.author: Stephen Dobson
reviews.text: I brought my 2024 Ram 2500 Big Horn in for an oil change some time back now. Once it was time to change the oil again, the oil plug was not able to be removed from another Service Provider (my wife took the truck out of town) due to overtorquing the plug. These plugs only require a maximum of 25 ft pounds as per manufacturer specifications. The plug on my truck was overtorqued to say the least. I still have the old oil plug. I will say that Mr. Brian defused an angry situation by listening to my frustration, and did what he could to loosen the plug. I was sent to the Warrenton location because they had the only replacement plug. I will also add that I have driven this Truck from Alaska to Florida and back to NC. I have also spent 1800 hours in Tech School alone learning Marine Mechanics. This most certainly included learning the extreme importance of TORQUE RATIOS as well as TENSILE STRENGTH OF A BOLT. I don't need an Education on how "Today's vehicles tell you when there is something wrong with the vehicle.", as I was told over the phone by the Store Manager. When it comes to tires and alignments, the vehicle in fact does not tell you what's wrong. I planned on having the tires replaced and the alignment done here untiI this debauchery of an oil change. I appreciate everything that Mr.Brian did to help my Situation. I will however not return to this location for any other work. Maybe it's time to make Mr. Brian the new Manager.

reviews.author: mark brown
reviews.text: Heard a strange noise under our car while traveling on a long road trip, and Pete Smith fit us in at the end of their day. They were great and so helpful!
